name: Rhys Llewellyn
bio:
Rhys Llewellyn's motorsport journey began not in the grandstands, but tinkering in his father's garage in Cardiff. A lifelong fascination with engines and a degree in mechanical engineering led him to a junior engineering role at a local racing team. His meticulous nature and ability to manage complex projects quickly saw him rise through the ranks. He joined Andretti Global three years ago, initially as a project manager, and his efficiency and calm demeanor under pressure made him the ideal candidate for Head of Operations.

Rhys approaches his role with a data-driven mindset, constantly seeking ways to optimize processes and improve communication across departments. He believes that a well-oiled machine behind the scenes is just as crucial to success as the talent on the track. His commitment to excellence and unwavering loyalty make him a respected and valued member of the Andretti Global team. He is known for his ability to remain composed even in the most chaotic situations, earning him the nickname "The Rock" among his colleagues.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Rhys is of average height with a lean build and a perpetually focused expression.

quirks: Always has a detailed to-do list in his pocket.
Drinks copious amounts of Earl Grey tea throughout the day.
Insists on personally checking the torque settings on critical components before each race.
